verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex's own docs say it handles direct deposits for employees in one click, so the core alternative to writing checks is covered. Nothing in the evidence documents next-day or 2-day deposit timing, which is the 'fast' half of the story. Missing for 10: documented next-day or 2-day direct deposit speeds, funding and cutoff timelines, independent or hands-on corroboration of deposit speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay employees by fast (next-day or 2-day) direct deposit instead of writing checks

citations.quote: In just one click, Paychex handles direct deposits, tax filings, and pay stubs/checks for your team.
